provider: mocked fixtures; no real provider generation
workflows: Protected concept teaching through live browser/API
Session start, pause, reload recovery, resume, paper checkpoint, completion without mastery
Curated multisource outline, worker generation, refresh, review
Fixed original curated check scored on mobile as assisted builder evidence; answer key hidden and replay denied
Algebra multisource course with subject filtering and persistent sequenced lessons
Inspect request-derived preferences and persist explicit course details without attaching stored student records
Saved course renders sanitized Markdown, math, highlighted code and tables; hostile content and fallback bounds verified
Fixture-backed original generation, answer-key review, scoring, shared progress
Single-lesson edit and bounded regeneration create reviewed course revisions while preserving the original and its scored evidence
Replacement knowledge check preserves teaching content and prior evidence, requires provider confirmation and accuracy review, and scores once as assisted builder evidence
Module editing validates native duration and prerequisite sequence, retains failed drafts, preserves teaching/evidence in a reordered course revision and requires review
Institution policy change and audit via browser
Monthly budget, scheduled assessment windows, retention settings and scoped beta approval
Mapped task/onboarding policy denials and anonymous-generation identity enforcement prevent provider calls; grade predictions retain numerical results without disallowed AI insights
Mobile layout, keyboard focus, student beta and direct API denial
Explicit preview consent, grade with tutor disabled, real reviewed scorer/hint, shared evidence, feedback, withdrawal and private export
All restricted activities show an access explanation without a blocked progress request
Legacy Text Dissector discloses deterministic excerpt fallback with no provider call, then honors tutor revocation
